title: A traumatized Area 51 worker saw reptilian beings in a basement

tellings.quote: they have a friend who worked at Area 51 or might be a friend of a friend but they met him and he was totally traumatized

plain: A man who worked at Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada, says he saw reptilian beings in a basement there and came away badly shaken. Michels repeats this from Garrett McNamara and Nicole McNamara, who told him they have a friend, or perhaps a friend of a friend, who worked there and whom they found 'totally traumatized'. If true, it would put living non-human beings inside a US military base.
